task: Make the Lattice CLI live Authority runner send signed story/job claim selectors so it cannot accidentally claim stale queued jobs from another story.
outcome: After running the authority live smokes, the terminal shows JobClaim accepts storyId/jobId, autopilot authority claim bodies include claim.storyId for the requested story, authority_enforce_runner claim bodies include claim.storyId, and the stale queued other-story job regression passes instead of producing claimed-job-story-mismatch.
facts: Server story B-28c5 already added signed storyId/jobId selector enforcement before leasing.
Current CLI live claim paths send provider/session but not storyId, so they still make broad claims.
SSE jobs.available is only an advisory hint; signed POST /jobs/claim remains the ownership boundary.
INIT reviewers required explicit stale queued job regression evidence, not only payload field assertions.
constraints: Do not change server code in this story.
Do not add queue purge, cancel endpoints, retry loops, or multi-tenant behavior.
Keep broad generic runner claims valid where no story selector is intended.
Only fix the real claim identity mismatch and keep logic consistent with server B-28c5.
unknowns: Exact test edits needed in existing smokes to model stale queued other-story jobs without live staging dependency.
